title: fix(replay): fail closed on unreadable payload inventories
body:
## Summary

Repair one false-equivalence case in PR2040's generated-payload comparator with a source-authenticated, opt-in successor.

```diff
- Path.rglob silently omits an unreadable subtree
+ scandir and lstat propagate access/iteration/metadata failures
+ CLI exits 2 without publishing a partial comparison report
```

New package: `research/strict-payload-fail-closed-inventory/`. Its task card, 12 exact dependency pins, bounded replay hook and open next question are included. Frozen comparators, source archives and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: two differing certificates under chmod000 subdirectories produce exit 0 and `{"counts": {}, "equivalent": true}`. The new CLI regression failed against the retained inventory.
- After: the same fixture produces exit 2, an access-error diagnostic and no report. Readable proof changes still fail; equivalent formatting still passes.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes all 15 test groups, the complete 105-file corpus, 39 retained adverse witnesses and 22 timing-field rejection controls. Twelve injected EACCES/EIO cases cover both sides and open/iteration/stat failures, including handle cleanup.
- Full optimized replays pass on CPython 3.12.15 and 3.13.5, Linux x86_64. Git-free read-only export, exact publication-byte preflight and Ruff pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/strict-payload-fail-closed-inventory
```

Base main `5a0dc2c0f4685b02bef7776bc196c7c1231cbac1`; PR2040 source head `d31c1418c0c23994d1444dbd9d356b9a8238fd5e`. Priority revision 5. Final pre-submission main `f646a7fb75f7d854a881e07fefb13fdfe7631c86` leaves guidance and dependencies unchanged. Complete overlap refresh covered 496 open PRs, 1593 discussion records and 2117 closed PRs. [Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2919).

Credit commdata2338's strict comparator/audit, Josie Elliston's portability predecessor, Maxime Fleury and Antoine Olivier's payload convention, and the retained supplier/archive authors. PR2693's paired traversal and Arham Tahir's PR2803 integer repair are separate work, not imported here.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. Only a new opt-in package and replay registration.

**Blast radius:** isolated.

The stricter inventory rejects special files and imposes a 1,000,000-entry budget per tree. Inputs must remain stable; concurrent replacement, symlink races and atomic snapshots are outside scope. Existing parser resource limits remain. Self-reviewed only; no hosted CI, Windows/macOS execution, selected cold replay, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.
